info.name: Learning
info.summary: Spaced Repetition Learning with Leitner System
info.description:
**Learning** is a powerful flashcard and quiz app for Nextcloud with a built-in Leitner 5-box spaced repetition system.
Create question pools, share them with your team, and study efficiently using scientifically-proven spaced repetition.
## Features
- **AI Question Generator** — Paste text, let AI generate multiple-choice questions with preview and editing before import - **Smart Queue** — One-click "Jetzt Lernen" button reviews all due cards across every pool, prioritized by urgency - **Trouble Spots** — Focused practice on your hardest questions (3+ wrong, <30% accuracy) - **Daily Challenge** — One question per day with bonus XP reward for correct answers - **At-Risk Early Warning** — Instructors see which students are falling behind with risk scores and reasons - **Multiple Choice Quizzes** — Create pools with questions, multiple answers, and multi-select support - **Leitner Spaced Repetition** — 5-box system with automatic scheduling (1d, 3d, 7d, 14d intervals) - **Training Mode** — Quick quiz sessions with immediate feedback and score tracking - **Exam Mode** — Timed exams with configurable question count and animated snake timer - **Wahr/Falsch Mode** — Touch-friendly swipe-based true/false flashcard review - **Gamification** — XP, levels, 14 achievement badges, streak tracking, and level-up celebrations - **Daily Goal** — Configurable daily review target with visual progress ring and XP bonus - **Course Management** — Instructors create courses, assign pools, track student progress - **Course Leaderboard** — Ranked by XP with medal indicators and student detail drill-down - **Pool Sharing** — Share pools with other users (read or edit permissions) - **CSV/JSON Import** — Bulk import questions from CSV or JSON files - **Dashboard Widget** — See due questions at a glance from the Nextcloud Dashboard - **Activity Integration** — Badge unlocks appear in Nextcloud Activity stream - **Progress Tracking** — Stats, accuracy, mastery percentage per pool - **Multi-Language Support** — Translate questions and answers into any language - **Search** — Full-text search across all your question pools - **Mobile Optimized** — Touch-friendly responsive design
## Use Cases
- Employee Onboarding & Compliance Training - IT Certification Prep (CompTIA, Cisco, AWS) - University Courses & Exam Preparation - Language Learning Vocabulary - General Knowledge Retention
## Requirements
- Nextcloud 29, 30, or 31 - PHP 8.1+ - PostgreSQL 13+ or MySQL 8+
